strings.BANDIT2_SPECIAL_ALT_DESCRIPTION: <style=cIsDamage>Slayer</style>. Fire a revolver shot for <style=cIsDamage>600% damage</style>. Hitting with <style=cIsHealth>Backstab</style> grants <style=cIsDamage>stacking tokens</style>. Each <style=cIsHealth>Hemorrhage</style> stack on the enemy gives you an <style=cIsDamage>additional token</style>.
strings.RFS_BANDIT2_DESPERADO_TOKENS_KEYWORD: <style=cKeywordName>Stacking Tokens</style><style=cSub>Each token is a buff that gives your next Desperado shot 10% more damage. Collected tokens last 12 seconds, but the duration resets upon collecting more.</style>
